skills.name: Self-Defense Rush
skills.description: Rains blows on enemies, shouting "self-defense." Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -50% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Resistance -50% (7 sec)

skills.name: Salt Splash
skills.description: Purifies surroundings by sprinkling salt. Good effects on allies.  *Removes allies' debuffs  *ATK +320% (7 sec) *HP +400% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Mob
abilities.description: Mob Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy: Assassination
abilities.description: Has a set chance of making a Reaper appear, killing 1 enemy Ranger instantly when Rangers deploy.　  - Activates only in PVP and Guild Battles. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - Abilities with the same effect will not activate again for 3 seconds. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
